headline: Cannabis retail stores allowed by special permit in I-40 industrial zone, after 3-2 vote.
summary: Up to three stores may be approved, each only after a special permit hearing. Preschools, early childhood education centers, and daycare facilities were added to the list in section 4.16C, item 4. Also approved, 4-1, was a mixed-use floating zone amendment, application 505-26, with changes that raise a 25% minimum to 35% and allow one drive-through.
decisions: Approved text amendment allowing cannabis retailers by special permit in the I-40 zone, 3-2.
Approved mixed-use floating zone text amendment with changes, 4-1.
discussion: Cannabis retail text amendment: Public speakers, most of them opposed, cited youth risks, impaired driving, and mental health. The applicant said a regulated market is safer and that the 3% municipal tax would bring money to the town; members debated whether one store changes demand.

Mixed-use floating zone changes: Members asked for a 35% residential minimum and a single drive-through. Public speakers asked for a 60-acre minimum, 150-foot buffers near homes, and written fire and utility findings before any zone is applied.
Smoke shop rules: Members said smoke shops should face similar rules and should be looked at separately.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made and seconded. Voting beginning with Commissioner Leonardo. Yes. Yes. Uh, no. No. Yes. The text amendment passes.
